title: Marketing Manager - B2B IT Services
description:
**Are you an experienced B2B IT Services marketing professional looking to lead marketing initiatives, drive demand generation, and build impactful campaigns that contribute to business growth?**


Join **LevelShift** as a **Marketing Manager**, where you'll be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing integrated marketing campaigns across content, digital, email, social media, SEO/AEO, PPC, and lead generation. You'll lead a team of marketing professionals and work closely with business stakeholders, sales, content, design, and digital marketing teams to deliver measurable marketing outcomes.


**What You'll Do**

  

  

As a **Marketing Manager** at LevelShift, you will:


* Lead and manage a team of **Content Writers and Marketing Executives** to achieve campaign objectives and business targets.
* Own and execute the **marketing calendar and campaign plan** in alignment with organizational and business priorities.
* Plan, coordinate, and monitor integrated **B2B marketing campaigns** across email, social media, PPC, SEO/AEO, content marketing, and publications.
* Drive end\-to\-end campaign execution, including **campaign planning, content development, creative coordination, publishing, promotion, performance tracking, and optimization**.
* Review campaign performance regularly and drive **course corrections based on campaign data, engagement, lead quality, and conversion trends**.
* Partner with the **design team** to develop campaign creatives, marketing collateral, digital assets, and content required for campaign execution.
* Work closely with the **digital marketing team** to drive SEO/AEO, paid marketing, website optimization, and digital campaign performance.
* Own and manage the **content calendar**, ensuring timely development and publication of high\-quality in\-house and outsourced content.
* Monitor and maintain **websites, social media channels, landing pages, and other digital marketing assets**.
* Lead and guide the **lead generation team** in identifying relevant target accounts, prospects, and contacts for various campaigns.
* Establish campaign objectives, monitor KPIs, analyze performance, and identify opportunities to improve **marketing effectiveness and ROI**.
* Work closely with **sales and business stakeholders** to understand business priorities and align marketing campaigns with lead\-generation and pipeline objectives.
* Manage multiple marketing initiatives simultaneously while ensuring **quality, timelines, and campaign deliverables** are met.
* Establish and maintain marketing processes, quality standards, and operating practices across the team.
* Track and review team activities, campaign progress, and individual performance against defined targets.
* Conduct regular **team meetings, performance reviews, feedback sessions, and best\-practice discussions**.
* Mentor and develop team members through **performance improvement, capability building, and continuous learning**.
* Provide floor support and respond to **prospect enquiries** when required.
* Monitor team engagement and take proactive measures to support **employee retention and team stability**.
* Prepare and present regular **marketing performance, campaign, lead\-generation, and team status reports** to the reporting manager.
* Identify and implement **process improvements** to enhance marketing efficiency, campaign execution, and overall team productivity.
* Ensure compliance with applicable **information security policies, organizational processes, and quality standards**.
  

  

**How This Role Uses AI**


* Should be comfortable using **AI tools** to improve marketing strategy, campaign planning, content development, market research, analytics, and team productivity while ensuring responsible AI usage.
* Utilize AI\-assisted tools for **content creation, campaign ideation, SEO/AEO optimization, audience research, lead generation, personalization, reporting, and campaign analysis**.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools such as **ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and other GenAI and marketing technology platforms** to accelerate marketing execution.
* Explore opportunities to use AI for **customer segmentation, account research, content personalization, campaign optimization, lead qualification, and marketing analytics**.
* Encourage the marketing team to adopt AI responsibly while maintaining **data privacy, information security, brand guidelines, and organizational standards**.
* Identify opportunities where AI can improve **marketing workflows, campaign performance, content operations, reporting, and team productivity**.
  

  

**Your Skillset**


* **10\+ years of experience** in B2B marketing, preferably within the **IT Services, Technology, SaaS, or enterprise technology industry**, with proven experience in a managerial or leadership role.
* Strong understanding of **B2B IT Services marketing**, enterprise technology marketing, and demand\-generation strategies.
* Proven experience planning and executing **integrated marketing campaigns** across email, social media, PPC, SEO/AEO, content marketing, and digital channels.
* Strong knowledge of **SEO and AEO** and their application within B2B marketing.
* Experience managing **marketing technology platforms and tools** used for campaign execution, automation, analytics, lead generation, and content management.
* Strong **analytical mindset** with the ability to interpret campaign performance, lead\-generation metrics, engagement, conversion, and other marketing KPIs.
* Experience managing **content strategy, content calendars, content development, and publishing activities**.
* Strong experience coordinating with **content, design, digital marketing, lead generation, sales, and business teams**.
* Proven experience in **team management, mentoring, performance management, capability building, and target management**.
* Ability to analyze campaign performance and drive **data\-driven course corrections and optimization**.
* Strong understanding of **lead generation, target account identification, demand generation, prospect engagement, and campaign\-driven pipeline creation**.
* Strong **project management and deadline\-management skills**, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities.
* Excellent **stakeholder management, communication, presentation, leadership, analytical, and problem\-solving skills**.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-oriented, and collaborative environment.
* Strong focus on **quality, process compliance, information security, and operational excellence**.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with **B2B marketing, digital marketing, SEO/AEO, marketing technology, AI, and emerging marketing trends**.
  

  

**Why LevelShift?**


* Lead impactful **B2B IT Services marketing and demand\-generation initiatives** that contribute to business growth.
* Own and influence marketing strategy across **content, digital, email, social media, SEO/AEO, PPC, and lead generation**.
* Work closely with **sales, business leaders, technology teams, content, design, and digital marketing professionals**.
* Build and mentor a high\-performing marketing team while developing strong **leadership and strategic marketing capabilities**.
* Gain exposure to modern **marketing technology, AI\-powered tools, digital platforms, and data\-driven marketing practices**.
* Drive continuous improvement in **campaign performance, lead generation, brand visibility, and marketing effectiveness**.
* Access continuous learning opportunities, professional development programs, and exposure to emerging **marketing and AI technologies**.

title: Creative Head
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Creative Manager to join our team and work closely with the evolving Maarrs product

portfolio.

This is not a conventional Creative Manager role.

The role combines hands\-on creative production, design execution, video creation, team formation and

leadership, and UI/UX quality oversight, and will require the individual to work across different creative

aspects of the product and business.

As an early\-stage startup, we believe that roles cannot always be restricted to a fixed job description.

Everyone is expected to contribute wherever required, take ownership and help build the organisation and

product.

Most importantly, we are not looking for someone who already knows everything.

Creative tools, production techniques, product knowledge and new AI\-enabled creative capabilities can all be

learned and developed over time. What is much harder to teach is attitude, ownership, work ethic, curiosity,

adaptability and willingness to learn and contribute.

That is what we value most.

**What We Are Looking For**

**We are looking for someone who:**

 Has a strong work ethic and takes ownership of commitments.

 Has a genuine willingness to work and contribute, rather than waiting to be told what to do.

 Is curious and has a willingness to explore, question and understand.

 Is willing to learn new creative skills, tools and ways of working.

 Can operate comfortably in an environment where things are still being built and refined.

 Is flexible and adaptable when priorities or responsibilities change.

 Can work across creative functions rather than being restricted by a narrow job description.

 Is comfortable taking responsibility for something and following it through to completion.

 Can think beyond the immediate creative task and understand where the product and brand are heading in the

future.

 Wants to build their own capabilities and career alongside the growth of the product and organisation.

 Has good professional ethics, reliability and discipline.

 Can work independently while also collaborating effectively with others.

 Brings structure and clarity even when the situation itself is not completely structured.

The role will broadly operate across creative production, design, video and creative team management:

 Work closely with the CEO on creative execution and production priorities.

 Build, develop and lead the creative team across design and video functions, with hands\-on creative

production remaining a core responsibility.

 Oversee the UI/UX and front\-end design department — reviewing and ensuring quality of output, not hands\-on

execution.

 Drive creative marketing ideas and campaign concepts.

 Create and execute end\-to\-end video production, including 2D animation, 3D animation, motion graphics,

AI\-generated video and video editing, while also overseeing the quality and delivery of video outputs.

 Design and oversee brand assets including logos, posters, full branding kits, letterheads and marketing

collateral.

 Manage design and video workflows from brief to final delivery across multiple concurrent projects.

 Maintain production quality and ensure creative outputs are delivered to the required standard and within

agreed timelines.

 Coordinate creative priorities across multiple projects and ensure that agreed actions are followed through to

completion.

 Provide creative direction and quality review while remaining hands\-on where production execution is required.

**Creative Skills \& Experience**

The following would be advantageous, with strong practical proficiency expected for the core production tools:

 Adobe Premiere Pro.

 Adobe After Effects.

 Adobe Photoshop.

 Adobe Illustrator.

 DaVinci Resolve (color grading).

 Canva (professional\-level use).

 Figma (UI/UX design).

 2D animation and motion graphics.

 3D animation.

 AI video generation tools.

 Video editing and post\-production.

 Brand identity design, including logos, letterheads and full branding systems.

 Poster and marketing collateral design.

 UI/UX oversight and quality review of application design and front\-end output.

 Creative team leadership and creative workflow management.

Added advantage (not mandatory):

 Pre\-production experience, including script writing.

 Cinematography knowledge — camera positioning, shot composition, and the ability to advise across

production departments.

A strong portfolio demonstrating expert\-level execution across design AND video disciplines simultaneously is

important. Proven experience leading a creative team, working directly with executive leadership, and

independently managing multiple creative workflows end\-to\-end would be advantageous.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month
